label: DSINE Normals
description: DSINE single-frame surface normals (camera space). Output: raw EXR at plate size, 0-1 encoded; the node shows them decoded to -1..1.
usage: Pick the frame with 'frame' (Set to current frame) - only that frame is sent.
Set 'fov' close to the shot's lens; more iterations = cleaner, slower.
Output: 0-1 encoded normals; the node shows them decoded to -1..1.
Press Render in ComfyUI; Bring in output reads the result under the node.
highlights: what the model sees. 'clip' (default) cuts at 1 and keeps shadows open. 'roll off' compresses highlights but crushes deep shadows.
License (checked 2026-11): DSINE (Imperial College) - non-commercial, internal or academic research only. Paid work needs a license from Imperial.

output.tooltip: Normals are vectors, not colour: written and read as raw. DSINE's own output is 8-bit, so the half-float EXR adds no precision.

knobs.name: fov
knobs.label: fov
knobs.tooltip: Horizontal field of view of the lens in degrees (DSINE is camera-aware). Desqueeze anamorphic first.

knobs.name: iterations
knobs.label: iterations
knobs.tooltip: Refinement passes (1-20). Raise for detailed scenes.

knobs.name: resolution
knobs.label: resolution
knobs.tooltip: Processing resolution, step 64. Higher = more detail, more VRAM. The result is scaled back to plate size.

knobs.name: highlights
knobs.label: highlights
knobs.tooltip: What the model sees; only the input changes, as normals is data and isn't converted back. clip (default): values above 1 become 1 (colorimetric), shadows stay open. roll off: the plate goes in through ACES Output - sRGB, so highlights are compressed instead of cut, but deep shadows are crushed. Try roll off on shots with large blown-out areas.
